newsitem.title: USA: Howmet Corp wins Joint Strike Fighter contract.
newsitem.headline: Howmet Corp wins Joint Strike Fighter contract.

text.p: Howmet Corp said Wednesday that it was selected by United Technologies Corp's Pratt & Whitney Space & Government Operations to manufacture the turbine airfoil castings for the new Joint Strike Fighter program.
A statement issued by Howmet did not say how much the contract is worth.
Howmet said it will manufacture single-crystal airfoils for the program at its facilities in Dover, New Jersey and Whitehall, Michigan.
Howmet said it will produce 20 sets of airfoils later this year, 10 each for the Boeing and Lockheed designs.
Full production is scheduled to begin in 1998, the company said.
Total production over the life of the contract has the potential of a million or more castings, the company said.
